title: P104: bound all 18 rank-one helper singleton zeros by lost targets
body:
## Summary
Complete singleton-zero classification across original public and owned #7481 MOVE histories.

## Result
Every one of 18 helper zeros allows exactly one rank-1 cache credit, canceled by the lost original rank-1 target. Twelve are consequences of the earlier neutral-subset theorem; six public-cache cases are new.

## Verification
Independent exact-Q/prime-field source replays, chronological coframe checks, nine failure mutations and source-only registered tests. Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rank1-zero-cache-bound`.

## Scope and kappa
Singleton zeros only; no joint-helper extension, physical public retirement, new source or improved kappa. All five foundational assumptions remain.
